title: HONG GALAXY TRAILER
summary: A 16-second official-channel science-fiction trailer with five sparse caption records. The surviving dialogue invokes a hundred-year treaty, a fragment about “your peace,” a fictional speaker saying their people are dying, and a narrator framing this as a story of two planets. Every word and source mask remains. The work explicitly presents a story, so its treaty, people, deaths and planets are fictional worldbuilding—not David Choe biography, real geopolitics or evidence about an actual conflict. Character names, sides, planets, canon details and performers are absent; uncertain turn boundaries and the masked word are not invented. Zero named turns and zero voice-enrollment windows ship.
